name: Helio Courier
summary: Four-seat STOL bush plane famous for flying off tiny strips. A strut-free high wing with automatic slats and huge flaps sits on very tall gear.

wings: High cantilever wing with no lift struts
Full-span leading-edge slats and very large flaps, with short ailerons confined to the outer wing
engines: Single engine in a long, smooth cowling
Large three-blade propeller on the geared 295 hp models
fuselage: Tall, boxy four-seat cabin with large side windows
Very tall, long-travel main gear; tailwheel on most (tricycle on HT-295)

tellTales: High wing with no struts, a slatted leading edge and huge flaps
Very tall landing gear under a boxy four-seat cabin

confusedWith.howToTell: The Cessna 180/185 has a lift strut under each wing and plain flaps; this aircraft's high wing has no struts and carries full-span slats and giant flaps on much taller gear.
A Maule's wing is braced by a lift strut and has simple flaps; this one is a strut-free cantilever wing with a visibly taller fin and much taller gear.
The Bush Hawk is a strut-braced high-wing with a large flat-six and plain flaps; the strut-free slatted wing here is the giveaway.
The 182 is a strut-braced high-wing with tricycle gear and standard flaps; this aircraft has a cantilever wing, slats and a tailwheel.
